name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | B2B SaaS Onboarding, Retention & Cross-Functional Advocacy
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years owning the full post-sale journey in B2B SaaS and MarTech, onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, for both direct-customer and partner-network portfolios. Track record includes ~94% partner retention, QBR and reporting frameworks tracking ROI and adoption, and a direct feedback channel into Product and Engineering. Builds and deploys AI-driven workflows daily as the founder of an automation practice, with a working, hands-on opinion on where AI actually changes CS motions. New ground: no direct hands-on experience with Postgres, SQL, or cloud infrastructure specifically, the technical fluency below comes from CRM architecture, API integrations, and AI agent building rather than database administration, worth saying directly.
